title: Impossible To Satisfy Every Litigant, Judge's Morality Should Be Governed By Sensible Sections Of Society: Justice Dixit Krishna Shripad Retires
description: The Orissa High Court held a Full-Court Reference on Friday (July 17) to bid farewell to Justice Dixit Krishna Shripad, the third senior-most Judge of the High Court, upon his superannuation from office with effect from July 19, 2026. The event, which was chaired by Chief Justice Harish Tandon, saw attendance of the Judges of the High Court, Justices R. Nataraj and E.S. Indiresh of the Karnataka High Court, Advocate General of Odisha Pitambar Acharya, Deputy Solicitor General of India (DSGI) PK
